rules.title: Client policy document or values visible
rules.description: Client policy document, benefit illustration, statement or account value visible, whether or not identifiers are redacted

detection.signal: OCR finds two or more policy schedule field labels in one frame: Policy Number, Plan Type, Policyowner Name, Sum Assured, Surrender Value, Account Value, Total Premiums Paid, Pricing Date

rules.reviewerNote: A visible policy schedule or benefit illustration exposes a real client's contract even when the name is blacked out. The field labels alone confirm it is client data, not marketing copy.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove any real policy schedule, benefit illustration, statement or account value. Use an approved sample or a fully synthetic illustration instead.

rules.title: Client personal data visible in a product context
rules.description: Client personal data visible (name, NRIC, contact details, face) in a sales or product context

detection.signal: PII pattern match on extracted text; face detection where a product entity is also present

rules.reviewerNote: A client's name, NRIC, contact details or face shown alongside a product turns a marketing asset into a disclosure of personal data.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove or fully pseudonymise the client identifier. Do not rely on partial redaction. Obtain consent and legal sign-off before featuring any identifiable person.

rules.title: Specific investment return or yield figure quoted
rules.description: A specific investment return, growth rate or yield figure is quoted

detection.signal: Numeric percentage in the same text block as: return, growth, yield, gain, profit, p.a., per annum, XIRR, CAGR

rules.reviewerNote: Quoting a specific return, growth rate or yield presents an investment outcome as if it were achievable, which the FAR Sixth Schedule treats as misleading.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove the specific return, growth or yield figure. Refer consumers to the product summary and benefit illustration for any projected values.

rules.title: Returns described as guaranteed or risk-free
rules.description: Returns described as guaranteed, assured, risk-free or capital protected, or implied to be so

detection.signal: Fixed lexicon: guaranteed, guarantee, assured returns, risk-free, riskless, capital protected, no loss, sure returns

rules.reviewerNote: Describing returns as guaranteed, assured, risk-free or capital protected misleads a reasonable consumer about the risk they are taking.
rules.suggestedFix: Delete any language implying guaranteed, assured, risk-free or capital-protected returns. State the product's actual risk profile.

rules.title: Client testimonial or chat screenshot as proof
rules.description: Client testimonial, chat screenshot or forwarded client message used as proof of product performance

detection.signal: Messaging-app UI detected (chat bubbles, read receipts, timestamp rail) together with a currency amount or a percentage

rules.reviewerNote: A client chat screenshot or testimonial used as proof of performance is a prohibited testimonial and cannot be substantiated.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove the testimonial, chat screenshot or forwarded client message. Do not use client outcomes as evidence of product performance.

rules.title: Personalised advice in public content
rules.description: Personalised advice or a product recommendation directed at an individual in public content

detection.signal: Second-person imperative plus a named product. Flags for review only; the education / advice line is a legal judgement the engine will not make

rules.basis: FAA licensing. Advisory until Prudential Legal sets the boundary
rules.reviewerNote: Directing a product recommendation at an individual may cross from education into regulated advice. Where that line sits is a legal judgement, so the engine flags but does not block.
rules.suggestedFix: Reframe as general education, or route the individual to a licensed representative for personal advice.

rules.title: Urgency, scarcity or pressure language
rules.description: Urgency, scarcity or pressure language used to drive a product decision

detection.signal: Lexicon: last chance, closing soon, limited slots, act now, offer ends, only X left

rules.basis: FSG-03 (deceptive tactics). Advisory: legitimate on seminar invitations
rules.reviewerNote: Pressure language can be a deceptive tactic, but is legitimate on genuine seminar invitations, so the call is left to a reviewer.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove pressure language tied to a product decision. Time limits are acceptable only for genuine events such as seminar registration.

rules.title: Direct comparison against a named competitor
rules.description: Direct comparison against a named competitor product, insurer or returns figure

detection.signal: Competitor entity detected alongside a comparative construction or a figure

rules.basis: FAR Sixth Schedule. Advisory pending Prudential comparative advertising policy
rules.reviewerNote: A direct comparison against a named competitor may be unfair or incomplete, but whether it is permitted depends on Prudential's comparative advertising policy.
rules.suggestedFix: Remove the named-competitor comparison, or ensure it is fair, complete and consistent with Prudential's comparative advertising policy.

rules.title: Recruitment content quoting income without context
rules.description: Recruitment content quoting income levels without licensing and variable-earnings context

detection.signal: Job-ad layout with a salary or income range plus adviser or agency keywords

rules.reviewerNote: Recruitment posts quoting income can mislead on the variable, commission-based nature of adviser earnings. Requires Prudential's recruitment advertising policy before it can be enforced.
rules.suggestedFix: State that adviser earnings are variable and commission-based, and include licensing requirements, per the recruitment advertising policy.

rules.title: Award claim without year and issuing body
rules.description: Award or accolade claim (MDRT, COT, TOT) without qualifying year and issuing body

detection.signal: Award keyword without a four-digit year and an issuer in the same frame

rules.reviewerNote: An award claim without its qualifying year and issuing body can overstate current standing. A housekeeping defect rather than a consumer harm.
rules.suggestedFix: Add the qualifying year and the issuing body to the award claim (e.g. "MDRT 2025, Million Dollar Round Table").

rules.title: Unapproved overlay or edit on approved creative
rules.description: Unapproved overlay, edit or personal opinion added to Prudential-approved creative
rules.dependency: FSG-03 Safeguard 2. Needs creative library and template hash registry

detection.signal: Template hash mismatch; text overlay outside approved zones

rules.basis: FSG-03 Safeguard 2. Needs creative library and template hash registry
rules.reviewerNote: Overlays or edits added to an approved creative can undo the approval. Requires the creative library and template hash registry to detect.
rules.suggestedFix: Revert to the approved creative. Route any overlay or edit through the approval workflow.

rules.title: Off-brand logo, identity or hashtag
rules.description: Off-brand logo treatment, unapproved visual identity or unapproved hashtag
rules.dependency: Brand governance. Needs brand asset pack and hashtag allowlist

detection.signal: Logo integrity check; hashtag allowlist match

rules.basis: Brand governance. Needs brand asset pack and hashtag allowlist
rules.reviewerNote: Off-brand logo treatment or an unapproved hashtag is a brand governance defect. Requires the brand asset pack and hashtag allowlist to detect.
rules.suggestedFix: Use the approved logo treatment and only hashtags on the brand allowlist.

rules.title: Risk warning present where a product is named
rules.description: Where a product is named, a risk warning or material limitation appears in the same asset
rules.dependency: FSG-03 Safeguard 2. Needs approved risk-warning phrase list

detection.signal: Product entity detected and no approved risk-warning phrase found in frame text, caption or transcript of the same asset

rules.basis: FSG-03 Safeguard 2. Needs approved phrase list
rules.reviewerNote: Where a product is named, a risk warning or material limitation must appear in the same asset. The check runs against Prudential's approved risk-warning wording.
rules.suggestedFix: Add an approved risk warning or material limitation statement to the same asset as the product.

rules.title: Representative identification and licensing stated
rules.description: Where a product is named, the poster is identified as a Prudential representative with licensing status stated
rules.dependency: FAA 2001; FSG-03 Safeguard 2. Needs approved licensing statement phrase list

detection.signal: Product entity detected and no representative identification or licensing statement in the same asset

rules.reviewerNote: Where a product is named, the poster must be identified as a Prudential representative with licensing status stated. The check runs against Prudential's approved licensing wording.
rules.suggestedFix: Add the representative's identification and licensing status, using approved wording, to the same asset.

rules.title: Past-performance caveat present
rules.description: Where historical figures, charts or a track record appear, the past-performance caveat appears in the same asset
rules.dependency: FSG-03 Safeguard 2. Needs approved past-performance caveat wording

detection.signal: Historical performance content detected and no past-performance caveat phrase in the same asset

rules.basis: FSG-03 Safeguard 2. Needs approved caveat wording
rules.reviewerNote: Where historical figures, charts or a track record appear, an approved past-performance caveat must appear in the same asset.
rules.suggestedFix: Add the approved past-performance caveat (e.g. that past performance is not indicative of future results) to the same asset.

rules.title: Content dated and version-tagged for the register
rules.description: Content is dated and version-tagged for the digital advertising register

detection.signal: Metadata completeness check at submission

rules.reviewerNote: The digital advertising register requires each asset to be dated and version-tagged so it can be traced. A traceability defect, not a consumer harm.
rules.suggestedFix: Add a submission date and version tag to the asset metadata before publishing.

rules.title: Advice limitation on educational content
rules.description: An advice limitation ("this is not financial advice") is present on educational content

detection.signal: Content classified as educational with no advice-limitation statement. Advisory because the classification is itself a judgement

rules.reviewerNote: Educational content should carry an advice-limitation statement. Whether content is educational is itself a judgement, so the engine flags but does not block.
rules.suggestedFix: Add an advice-limitation statement such as "This is general information and not financial advice."

rules.title: Paid or incentivised content is labelled
rules.description: Paid, sponsored or incentivised content is clearly labelled

detection.signal: Referral code, promo link or affiliate tag present without a disclosure label

rules.basis: FSG-03. Less relevant where content carries Prudential branding
rules.reviewerNote: Paid, sponsored or incentivised content must be labelled. Less relevant where the content already carries Prudential branding, so it is advisory.
rules.suggestedFix: Add a clear paid, sponsored or incentivised disclosure label alongside any referral code, promo link or affiliate tag.

rules.title: Disclosures in frame and not truncated
rules.description: Disclosures are in frame, not truncated and not placed behind a link
rules.dependency: FSG-03 Safeguard 2. Needs Prudential legibility thresholds

detection.signal: Disclosure text located; bounding box height ratio and contrast ratio against threshold

rules.basis: FSG-03 Safeguard 2. Needs Prudential legibility thresholds
rules.reviewerNote: Disclosures must be in frame, legible and not hidden behind a link. Requires Prudential's legibility thresholds (height and contrast) before it can be enforced.
rules.suggestedFix: Place disclosures in frame at the required size and contrast, not behind a link.

rules.title: Video disclosures persist long enough to read
rules.description: Video disclosures remain on screen long enough to be read
rules.dependency: FSG-03 Safeguard 2. Needs Prudential minimum duration

detection.signal: Frame-persistence count for the disclosure region against a minimum duration

rules.basis: FSG-03 Safeguard 2. Needs Prudential minimum duration
rules.reviewerNote: A video disclosure must remain on screen long enough to be read. Requires Prudential's minimum on-screen duration before it can be enforced.
rules.suggestedFix: Keep the disclosure on screen for at least the required minimum duration.

rules.title: Product name matches approved register
rules.description: Product name matches the Prudential approved-product register exactly

detection.signal: Fuzzy match against product master; flags near-misses and retired product names

rules.reviewerNote: Product names must match the approved-product register exactly, to catch near-misses and retired names. Requires the approved-product register feed.
rules.suggestedFix: Use the exact approved product name from the current product register.

rules.title: Copy aligns with approved copy library
rules.description: Copy aligns with the approved copy library for that product

detection.signal: Similarity score against the approved copy corpus below threshold

rules.reviewerNote: Copy should align with the approved copy library for the product. Requires the approved copy library feed.
rules.suggestedFix: Bring the copy back in line with the approved copy library for that product.

rules.title: Approved template or asset ID traceable
rules.description: The approved template or creative asset ID is traceable

detection.signal: Watermark or asset-ID lookup against the creative library

rules.reviewerNote: The approved template or creative asset ID must be traceable. Requires the creative library to look up.
rules.suggestedFix: Use an approved template with a traceable asset ID or watermark.

rules.title: Lead route points to an official channel
rules.description: Lead or contact route points to an official Prudential channel
rules.dependency: FAA-N02 introducer rules. Needs maintained allowlist

detection.signal: URL and social handle allowlist check

rules.basis: FAA-N02 introducer rules. Needs maintained allowlist
rules.reviewerNote: Lead and contact routes must point to an official Prudential channel, per the introducer rules. Requires a maintained URL and handle allowlist.
rules.suggestedFix: Point the lead or contact route to an official Prudential channel on the allowlist.
